data.one_liner: A modal progress indicator widget to block access to a widget during async operations.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget wrapper that displays a modal progress indicator (heads-up display) over its child widget. It accepts a boolean to toggle the loading state during asynchronous calls and allows custom spinner configurations.
use_when: You need to block user interaction on a screen or form during an asynchronous network or database call.
You want a simple overlay loading indicator without managing complex Z-index or Stack layers manually.
avoid_when: You need complex state management for the loading state outside of local widget state.
You prefer global loading overlays managed via a navigator observer rather than inline widget wrapping.
strengths: Simple and lightweight widget wrapper implementation.
Customizable progress indicators, opacity, colors, and dismissal behavior.
weaknesses: Requires manual state management (boolean flags) for controlling the loading state.
Limited to wrapping individual widget subtrees.
